title: Balanced Boolean functions have total influence at least one
statement: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a $\pm 1$-valued Boolean function that is balanced, meaning $\E[f] = 0$ under the uniform measure. Then its total influence satisfies $I[f] \ge 1$.
replaced: If $f$ takes values in $\{-1,1\}$, $\E[f] = 0$ and $n > 0$, then $I[f] \ge 1$.
